title: Two-party encrypted chat using a Noise XX handshake
summary: Implement the Noise XX pattern from scratch (or against a vetted reference) to bootstrap an authenticated channel between two peers, then layer a line-based chat protocol on top. Forward secrecy required; write a short doc on what XX provides versus what NN does not.
deliverables: Two peers complete the XX handshake and exchange chat lines under transport keys
Replay of a captured chat-line ciphertext is rejected
Doc: forward-secrecy property, identity-hiding property, what XX provides over NN
